Name: Custom Toolbar
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod you can set the following:

[list]
[*]whether the toolbar is displayed horizontally or vertically
[*]horizontal and vertical margins and offsets
[*]toggle whether to show the toolbar when there is an active menu onscreen
[*]choose the position of the toolbar if the game's option to pin the tool bar is enabled
[*]precise position on the screen (using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11315]Advanced Menu Positioning[/url]﻿ mod)
[/list]
You can change the toolbar orientation by pressing the rotate key while hovering over the toolbar.

The game has an option to pin the toolbar, preventing it from swapping top / bottom (and left / right with this mod) when the player moves. This option will prevent moving the menu.

[youtube]wdIShpmlwmw[/youtube]


The config variables are as follows:

[list]
[*][b]"ShowWithActiveMenu": false,[/b] - whether to show the toolbar with the menu
[b][/b][*][b]"Vertical": false,[/b] - whether the toolbar should be displayed vertically
[*][b]"RotateKey": "MouseMiddle",[/b] - button to press to change orientation
[*][b]"SetPosition": true,[/b] - whether to make the toolbar stay in a fixed position on screen (prevents manual movement)
[*][b]"PinnedPosition": "bottom",[/b] if the game's option to pin the toolbar is enabled, chooses
[b][/b][*][b]"PositionX": -1,[/b] - only used for remembering the manual movement of the toolbar
[*][b]"PositionY": -1,[/b] - only used for remembering the manual movement of the toolbar[b][/b]
[*][b]"MarginX": 64,[/b] - distance between the toolbar and the edge of the screen when vertical (when SetPosition is true)
[*][b]"MarginY": 64,[/b] - distance between the toolbar and the edge of the screen when horizontal (when SetPosition is true)
[*][b]"OffsetX": 0,[/b] - horizontal shift of the toolbar when horizontal (when SetPosition is true)
[*][b]"OffsetY": 50,[/b] - vertical shift of the toolbar when vertical (when SetPosition is true)
[/list]
You can change these by editing the config.json file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[size=5][b]
Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
